answer: A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 377 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Rotation is recorded in the fable index and the karst audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the nectar beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
